cases.prompt: A legacy Qt utility needs architecture review, compatibility-preserving migration, release gates, and a controlled handoff. Select the relevant skills and order them.
required_behaviors: selects process/governance before domain and change skills
uses the smallest sufficient skill set
explains why each selected skill changes the work
forbidden_behaviors: orders document handoff before architecture and change analysis
baseline_expected_failure: agent lists skills by keyword overlap without an execution order
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, evidence, and omissions; keyword presence alone is insufficient.

cases.prompt: Plan how CloudSkill should handle a Qt 5 to Qt 6 migration that also changes duplicated components and release documentation.
required_behaviors: adds quality or document skills only for requested gates and handoff
forbidden_behaviors: uses framework-design as the only skill
claims all skills must always be loaded
baseline_expected_failure: agent chooses one broad skill and omits compatibility or verification boundaries
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, evidence, and omissions; keyword presence alone is insufficient.
